claims.text: A 42-year-old non-smoking, non-alcoholic woman with no prior medical history presented to an outpatient department with bilateral breast pain and milky discharge lasting 18 months. Additional symptoms were headache, diplopia, blurred vision, skin darkening for one month and mild lower abdominal pain with heaviness. There was no history of nausea, vomiting, trauma or neurological deficits, and examination found no breast masses or axillary lymphadenopathy.
